newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares up in Beirut, Solidere steady.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares up in Beirut, Solidere steady.

text.p: Bank shares continued rising on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday as Banque Audi shares reached $18.625 from $18.5 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to $13.625 from $13.5.
Turnover in Audi shares was 15,832 againt Wednesday's 15,820 and 6,875 BLC shares were traded from 10,000.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.80 percent to 116.92.
Solidere shares were steady. A shares traded at $10.25 and B shares were unchanged at $10.75. A total of 250,950 Solidere shares were traded against Wednesday's 194,976.
Also traded were some 5,500 Ciments Libanais shares at $1.1875 from $1.15625 last Friday when they were last traded.
Total BSE turnover was 279,157 shares for a value of $2,996,962 against 220,796 shares for a value of $2,446,612.
There was no trade in the three other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.35 percent to 900.94 and the LISPI rose 0.48 percent to 83.16.
